description: Canonical Shared Chat -> Forge task-add boundary contract. This file is mirrored byte-identically in the Shared Chat repository so both sides review the same boundary without a cross-checkout dependency. Any change to this file changes its pinned SHA-256 and must be mirrored deliberately.
title: Signal Shelf CLI
objective: Record operational signals with add, list, search, and stats commands.
scope: The signal-shelf command-line interface and its SQLite persistence.
out_of_scope: No web UI, no network transport, and no changes outside signal_shelf/.
architecture_decisions: Supported levels are low, medium, and high.
Signals persist in a single SQLite database file.
constraints: Python standard library only; no new runtime dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: add accepts exactly the levels low, medium, and high; any other --level value, including info, warning, and critical, is rejected with exit code 2.
stats by_level always contains exactly the keys low, medium, and high, including zero counts.
